pages.seoDescription: Good Dog Academy runs warm, positive-reinforcement classes for puppies and grown dogs — puppy kindergarten, obedience, tricks, private sessions and a free evaluation. Small classes, certified trainers. Enroll online.

children: Friendly, force-free classes for puppies and grown dogs alike — small groups, big tails, and real-life manners that stick. Come learn together.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every class is led by a certified, positive-reinforcement trainer — no fear, no force, just treats, praise and patience that actually works.
We keep every group small so your trainer can see you, help you, and cheer you on. Fewer dogs, more progress, a room that stays calm.
Eight-week puppy or eight-year-old rescue, tiny or enormous, shy or bouncy — every dog is welcome, and every one goes at its own happy pace.
We teach the things you actually need — coming when called, walking politely, settling at home — so training works on a Tuesday, not just in class.

children: We train the way dogs actually learn — by rewarding the things we love and setting them up to get it right. No prong collars, no shouting, no fear. Just clear communication and a whole lot of encouragement.
It’s kinder, it’s more fun, and it builds a dog who wants to work with you — not one who’s just avoiding a correction. That bond is the whole point, and it’s the part that lasts.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Good Dog Academy is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A happy group class of dogs and owners training together on a sunny field

children: We started Good Dog Academy because training should feel good — for the dog and for you. Too many classes lean on fear and force; we wanted a place built entirely on kindness, treats and encouragement.

So this is a school where every dog is welcome, every owner is a beginner at something, and every small win gets a cheer. Come as you are, bring your dog exactly as they are, and let’s build something great together.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Not sure where to begin? Book a free meet & evaluation. We’ll get to know your dog, talk through your goals, and point you to the class that fits.
Classes run as a friendly series in our training hall — small, capped, and full of encouragement. You and your dog learn side by side with others doing the same.
Every class ends with exactly how to practice this week. The goal is a dog who’s wonderful at home and out in the world, not just in the room.
